create_timestamp_message: create a google.protobuf.Timestamp message with seconds and nanos fields
set_timestamp_seconds: set the seconds field on a Timestamp protobuf message to a Unix epoch value
set_timestamp_nanos: set the nanos field on a Timestamp protobuf message for sub-second precision
serialize_timestamp: serialize a Timestamp protobuf message to bytes using SerializeToString
parse_timestamp: parse a Timestamp protobuf message from serialized bytes using ParseFromString
